description: cure-tri-lane hooks: a PreToolUse guard that refuses lane commands running unsandboxed (command-type, no network; onFailure: block, so if the guard cannot run, times out or crashes, the Bash call is blocked rather than let an unsandboxed lane through; needs Claude Code 2.1.295+), and a SessionStart line listing benchmark defect windows that need a check (local file read, silent when none, fails open). Loads only where this plugin is installed.
